signals.text: I purchased a couple of these to use in our neighborhood yard sale.  Has pockets for a little mini note pad and pens.. ties are long enough to secure a wide size range of people.  The denim is medium color and what I would consider heavy.  I like them.  They'll be able to be used over and over again for years.  I haven't machine washed and dried yet, but it is my impression they will do as well any pair of blue jeans.
I love this denim skirt , it's so cute and fits great.

I ordered this modern looking denim shirt for my 21 year old daughter. I wasn't sure if she would like it, but she does. She is a fan of cropped tops already, so this was a fun way to incorporate denim tops into her life. The sizing fits as expected. She's gotten several compliments from it.
